generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's decurrent tree species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), family 57 Salicaceae (the willows and poplars): trees or shrubs; leaves alternate, simple; stipules small or leafy; flowers on separate trees, in catkins, with no perianth; ovary superior; fruit a capsule of many hairy seeds. APG's Salicaceae also holds most of the old Flacourtiaceae, trees and shrubs with alternate simple leaves and flowers with a perianth, often also on separate plants; their catkins, missing perianths and capsules belong to the willows' and poplars' genus files.
